cited.quote: Additional strength of 500 Home Guards to the existing sanctioned strength

rationale: The extracts are about Home Guards, but C1 (2024 GO) adds 500 Home Guards to the strength, C5 recruits fishermen youth, and C2-C4 only report numbers. None increases the work period (duty days) of Home Guards. Related activity only.

C1-C3 describe the Central Institute of Classical Tamil as already an autonomous Union institution, with a new building funded by the Union and opened in January 2022 (C3). No dedicated Tamil Nadu order, scheme or law to revive it or make it autonomous is shown. C4 and C5 are unrelated.

No extract mentions a new canal to Sathaiyar Dam from the Periyar-Vaigai primary canal. C2, C3 and C4 are GOs on rehabilitation and lining of existing Periyar and Vaigai canals, C1 is on river-linking projects elsewhere, and C5 is on Virudhunagar canals. Related activity only.

cited.quote: On February 26, 2024, The Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly unanimously passed the following resolution

rationale: C2 records the Assembly resolution of 26 February 2024 urging the Union Government to conduct a caste-wise census, which was sent to the Union. This is the state's formal step on the advocacy promise. C3 (2021) and C1 only state intent or requests without a dated formal step.

No extract shows zonal committees of farmers, officers and environmental experts to study water, soil, temperature and calamities. C2 describes water-budget software modules, C5 describes thematic departmental monitoring, C4 pollution board zonal offices, and C3 a statistics committee. Related activity only.

No extract concerns disbursement of a discount subsidy as a promise. C1 and C2 are audit reports on pre-2017 delays and cash discounts for bus chassis. C3 lists subsidy spending. C4 and C5 are income-tax circulars. Nothing is about the commitment.

cited.quote: deferment of the General Revision of Property

rationale: C2 only notes in passing that the general revision of property tax rates in Greater Chennai was deferred. It is not a GO or announced freeze until recovery. C1, C3, C4 and C5 concern revenue, GST, income tax and vehicle tax. No official step on a property tax freeze is shown.

cited.quote: decided to grant permission for conducting the below mentioned Tourism and Folk Art Festivals
The festival was conducted in Chennai in January 2023 and will be conducted in four other cities

rationale: C5 is a GO dated 2021-12-15 sanctioning the Folk Arts Festival in Chennai for January 2022, an event run every year. C3 reports Rs.6 crore sanctioned for the Namma Ooru Thiruvizha folk art festival, held in Chennai in January 2023 and planned for other cities. Annual government folk arts festival is shown.

No extract shows an order to revive welfare boards or ensure their functioning. C5 is a 2025 GO using funds of one board for an auto subsidy, and C3 mentions the Cine Workers Welfare Board history. C1, C2 and C4 are about unrelated bodies. Related activity only.

No extract shows welfare board meetings convened to review or resume operations. C5 only describes the Puthirai Vannar Welfare Board setup, while C1, C2 and C4 are rules on meetings of other bodies and C3 concerns mental health review boards.

cited.quote: framed guidelines for regulating culture of P. vannamei (White leg Shrimp) farming outside the jurisdiction

rationale: C1 states the Government framed guidelines regulating P. vannamei shrimp farming by G.O. (Ms) No. 05 dated 29.01.2024. This is a dedicated official order on shrimp farming practice. C2 and C3 mention CAA rule amendments and orders but give no date.

No extract shows a new special company, like TIDCO, SIDCO or TIIC, set up to finance micro and small business with banks. C1 adds existing TIIC as a UYEGP partner, C3 launches a credit guarantee scheme, C4 and C2 describe existing TIIC and schemes, C5 a startup fund. These are related but not the commitment.

The promise's object is unclear. C1 and C2 are a 2024 operation and maintenance policy for water supply schemes, including pipe leak checks. C4 is a farm pipe subsidy page with no start date. C3 and C5 are general monitoring notes. No extract clearly shows a special scheme for delivery and pipe monitoring.

cited.quote: The Advisory Committee was constituted vide G.O(Ms)No.04, Tourism, Culture and Religious Endowments (RE4.2) Department, dated.06.01.2022
The Advisory Committee is constituted as follows vide G.O (Ms) No.04, Tourism, Culture and Religious Endowments Department, dated: 06.01.2022

rationale: C3 and C4 show the Advisory Committee under the HR and CE Act, chaired by the Chief Minister with official and non-official members, constituted by G.O.(Ms) No.04 dated 06.01.2022, advising the Government on Hindu religious institutions. It was reconstituted later (C3).

cited.quote: Ensure priority for differently abled persons in the resettlement housing schemes

rationale: C5 is a 2026 GO approving a framework whose housing activities include priority for differently abled persons in resettlement housing, with accessible houses allocated as a target outcome. It is an official step but a plan, not an operational allotment. C1-C4 do not mention persons with disabilities.

C1 shows the Union notified Narikoravan and Kurivikkaran as Scheduled Tribes (Government of India Notification dated 03.01.2023; Central Act 01 of 2023), and the state followed with GO 21 of 2023. Vettaikarar, Lambadi and Badugar are not shown included; C2 and C4 list 37 tribes without them. Only part of the outcome occurred.

The process needing a railways no-objection certificate is not identified, and no extract concerns persuading the railways. C1 and C2 are about vehicle registration NOCs, C3 and C4 about planning-permission NOCs (Southern Railways is only listed among issuing agencies), C5 about passport NOCs for government servants.

cited.quote: 21 storm water drains for a length of 30.31 km at an estimated cost of Rs.82.15 crore
sanction was accorded for taking up 30.31 km of stormwater drains in 21 locations

rationale: C3 gives G.O.No.214 dated 17.05.2022 sanctioning storm water drains in Chennai suburban corporations and municipalities, and G.O.No.305 of 21.06.2023 for more; C1 and C2 add Thoothukudi works. Many works are completed or in progress, but coverage is of selected municipalities, not all.

No extract concerns withdrawal of cases against protesters of Sterlite, Hydrocarbon, Methane or Kudankulam projects. C1 is an audit report on finances, C2 and C5 are arbitration payment GOs, C3 is about a Kerala dispute, and C4 mentions Sterlite only as an oxygen source.
